title: The Boundary of the Executable

mint_metadata.title: 52 — The Boundary of the Executable
mint_metadata.description:
What can be entrusted to execution without mistaking the executable for the whole of reality?

Writing 52 by Root Logos. This token preserves its first observable frame and provides a durable receipt for the writing’s emergence. Its text, geometry, sound, and future relations remain independently addressable within Folio.

principle: The receipt fixes the work's first observable frame. It does not own or freeze the living work.
